---
name: Data error
about: Report a value that differs from its source or does not close thermochemically
labels: data-error
---

**Entry ID(s):** BDFE-xxxx

**What is stored:** (value with its unit and reference scale, e.g. −1.61 V vs Fc+/0)

**What the source prints:** (value with unit and scale; table/page/figure; DOI)

**Why it matters:** (closure residual, wrong couple, wrong reference electrode, …)

Every number needs its unit; potentials need their reference scale.
